_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', with 'approximately 6,500 products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own IPO prospectus); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', with 'approximately 6,500 products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own IPO prospectus); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +6% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.21; conservative 2yr -3%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY08-FY08 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -20.9%/yr (Q2 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7-trading-day median

BULL.desc: EPS -20.9%/yr (no FY08-FY08 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS -20.9%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY08-FY08: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2009-08-14) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (5.5% downside to Bear $15.68 / -39.1% upside to Bull $10.11) | Adj composite 1.45 vs market 1.24: gap +0.21 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +6% above the EPP floor $15.60 (60x FY09E $0.26) | Conservative 2-yr case: -2.9% total (-1.4%/yr) | At 63.8x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $21.95 sits above the BULL case; net revenue -20.9% YoY in Q2 FY09, forward revenues -20.9% (Q2 FY09 revenue growth (no Q3 FY09 guide in scope)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
